verdict.rationale: The SDK provides building blocks (FileSearchTool, CodeInterpreterTool, WebSearchTool, custom FunctionTools) that let developers construct agents which analyze data and surface insights/suggestions, but this is a developer framework rather than an end-user product that itself surfaces insights from 'my data' — any such experience must be built on top. Missing for 10: an out-of-the-box insight/suggestion UI or feature, first-party example of an insights product built on the SDK, and independent evidence of end-user-facing insight generation.
